channel.title: Magick Mastery | The Magick Muse
channel.description: Free witchcraft guides and deep dives from The Magick Muse, sourced from the same published scholarship as the Magick Manuscript.

item.title: Astrology for Witches: How to Time Your Spells by the Moon and Planets
item.description: You don't need to read a birth chart to use astrology in your craft. Here's how witches work with the seven planets, the moon, and magickal timing.

item.title: Herbalism for Witches: How to Work With Plants Safely and Powerfully
item.description: Herbs are one of the oldest tools in the craft. Here's what plant magick actually is, where it comes from, and how to start working with herbs safely.

item.title: Runes for Beginners: How to Read the Elder Futhark With Respect
item.description: Runes aren't just an ancient alphabet. Here's what they actually are, where they come from, and how to start reading the Elder Futhark with respect.

item.title: Divination for Beginners: How to Read Cards, Runes, and the Signs Around You
item.description: Divination isn't just the fortune-telling you see in the movies. Here's what it actually is, the main methods witches use, and how to choose the right one for your practice.

item.title: What a New Witch Actually Needs: Essential Tools and Your First Altar
item.description: You don't need a room full of expensive tools to start practicing witchcraft. Here's what actually earns a spot in your kit and how to set up your first altar.

item.title: Ten Years a Witch: What I’ve Unlearned and What I’d Tell My Beginner Self
item.description: Over a decade into practicing witchcraft, here's an honest look at what's shifted, what I've unlearned, and what I wish I could tell my beginner self.

item.title: The Spell Is Cast, Now What? A Guide to Disposing of Wax, Herbs, and Jars
item.description: Not sure what to do with the leftover wax, herbs, and jars from your spellwork? Here's a plain guide to ritual disposal, including which method to use for which type of working.

item.title: Ancestor Work for Beginners: How to Honor Your Lineage, Known or Unknown
item.description: New to ancestor work? Here's how to build a real relationship with your lineage, whether you know your family history or not, and why ancestor veneration is one of the most powerful foundations for any magickal practice.

item.title: Deity Work for Beginners: How to Approach the Gods With Respect
item.description: New to deity work? Here's how to approach gods and goddesses respectfully, build a real relationship over time, and avoid the mistakes beginners make most often.

item.title: Working With the Greek Gods: Kharis, Offerings, and Building a Real Relationship
item.description: New to Hellenic deity work? Here's a beginner's guide to the Olympian gods, the concept of kharis, and how to build a real reciprocal relationship the way the ancients did.

item.title: The Law of Similars: Why “Like Affects Like” Powers Almost Every Spell
item.description: The Law of Similars is one of the oldest and most important principles in magick. Here's what it actually means, how it works, and how to use it in your own practice.

item.title: How a Spell Actually Works: Candles, Jars, Sachets, and Sigils Explained
item.description: What actually goes into a spell? This breaks down four different spell formats so you understand the structure and can choose what works for you.

item.title: How to Spot Witchcraft Misinformation and Find Sources You Can Trust
item.description: The witchcraft corner of the internet is full of misinformation. Here's how to tell the difference between reliable sources and content that could actually harm your practice.

item.title: Research Is a Magickal Skill: How to Find Your Own Answers in the Craft
item.description: Research isn't separate from witchcraft. It is witchcraft. Here's how to find your own answers and why learning to do it is one of the most important parts of the craft.

item.title: Why Focus Is a Witch's Most Underrated Tool: Meditation for Beginners
item.description: Meditation for witches doesn't require an empty mind or an hour of silence. Here's what it actually is, why it matters for spellwork, and how grounding fits in.

item.title: Protection Magick for Beginners: Shields, Wards, and Banishing That Hold
item.description: New to witchcraft? Protection magick is where every practice should start. Learn the different types, when to use them, and how to build protections that actually hold.

item.title: What Is a Correspondence? The Concept That Holds All Spellwork Together
item.description: If you've seen the word 'correspondence' in witchcraft content and had no idea what it meant, this explains everything. It's simpler than it sounds and more useful than you'd think.

item.title: Shadow Work for Witches: What It Is and How to Begin Gently
item.description: Shadow work keeps coming up in witchcraft spaces for a reason. Here's what it actually is, why it matters, and how to start without overwhelming yourself.

item.title: Your First Tarot Deck: How to Choose, Cleanse, and Start Reading
item.description: Just got your first tarot deck? Here's how to choose one, cleanse it, bond with it, and actually start reading, without the myths and overcomplicated rituals.

item.title: What to Put in Your Grimoire: A Look Inside Mine
item.description: Not sure what goes in a grimoire? Here's a breakdown of every section in The Magick Manuscript and why each one earns its place in a serious witchcraft reference.

item.title: The Witchcraft Books That Built My Grimoire: A Beginner's Reading List
item.description: Not all witchcraft books are created equal. Here's a beginner reading list organized by topic, sourced from the same books that built The Magick Manuscript.
